definitions: To go or come after (a person or thing) in a procession or series.
To move behind (someone or something) and go in the same direction.
To act according to (an instruction or an example).
To understand (a spoken or written statement or argument).
To result or happen as a consequence of something else.
examples: Please follow me to the exit.
The dog followed its owner everywhere.
A recession often follows a period of inflation.
